outcome: Incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (blood loss > 500 mL within 24 hours postpartum)
cohort: A total of 160 patients who underwent vaginal delivery were included in the study, divided into an experimental group (n=80) and a control group (n=80).
finding: The tranexamic acid group showed a statistically significant reduction in the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage compared to the control group, along with a reduced need for blood transfusion and uterotonics.
mod_finding: Prophylactic intravenous tranexamic acid is effective in reducing the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal delivery.
